issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS Build fails on bob-cli-fb.5 keep-moving code: ViewBuilder for-loop at CapturePanelView.swift:3632 and type-check timeout at NotificationService.swift:854
issue.description:
Found during the bob-cli-fk landing while checking bob-cli-fk.6's proposed follow-up (note #3: macOS targets unverified because the Mac was offline). Not caused by epic bob-cli-fk.

bob-mac-capture master macOS CI ("macOS 26 SwiftPM" → Build) fails on the bob-cli-fk.6 commit 4f35460 (run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/41392931714) and on the earlier 72daffb (run 41386261558) with the same three compile errors:

1. `Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelView.swift:3632:9: error: closure containing control flow statement cannot be used with result builder 'ViewBuilder'` — a `for relationComplete in success.relationCompletes { guard … else { continue } … }` loop inside a ViewBuilder, added by 90bd9ba (bob-cli-fb.5, "feat(capture): add block presentation and pull-in choices").
2. `Sources/BobMacCapture/NotificationService.swift:854:30: error: the compiler is unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time` — the `keepMovingRows = captures.flatMap { … ?? [] + … ?? [] + relationCompletes.compactMap … }.filter { … }` chain, also added by 90bd9ba (bob-cli-fb.5).
3. `CapturePanelView.swift:4876:18` opaque-return error in eventWarningBanner — already tracked by bob-cli-fj (not part of this task).

Fix 1 and 2: replace the ViewBuilder `for`/`guard continue` with `ForEach` over a pre-filtered array (or move the loop into a helper returning a view), and split the keep-moving `flatMap` into typed intermediate arrays. Linux `just portable-check` cannot see these (BobMacCapture is macOS-only), so verify on macOS CI or the Mac.

Once Build is green (together with bob-cli-fj), confirm on macOS that bob-cli-fk.6's work compiles and passes: CaptureAgendaBufferTests (19 tests passed on Linux), the buffered CaptureAgendaDesignTests renders (760/620, light/dark, high-contrast), and `just typecheck-tests` for the rail wing / row buffer capsule views in CaptureAgendaView.swift. The 4f35460 run reported no CaptureAgendaView.swift errors, so the buffer views likely type-check already.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Compile errors, not test outcomes: identical errors at the same lines on two consecutive master runs (41386261558 on 72daffb, 41392931714 on 4f35460); both lines blame to 90bd9ba.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-fk landing found macOS CI Build red on two bob-cli-fb.5 compile errors no bead tracks, which also leaves bob-cli-fk.6's buffer views and renders unverified on macOS.
